zh.title: Jet2 退役全球最老波音 737‑800 結束 29 年服役
zh.summary: Jet2 退役註冊 G‑GDFD 的 737‑800；末班飛行 LS644 由伊比薩飛東米德蘭茲，同日轉飛曼徹斯特除塗裝。
body: Jet2 已退役一架服役 29 年的波音 737‑800（註冊號 G‑GDFD），結束全球最老同型機的飛行生涯。
該機於 10 月 18 日執行末班商業航班 LS644，從伊比薩飛往東米德蘭茲機場（EMA），隨後同日飛往曼徹斯特除去塗裝並準備歸還出租人。
機身序號 27982 為第二架 737‑800 原型機，累計超過 8 萬飛行小時；同時 Jet2 正加速引進空中巴士 A321neo，夏季已接收第 30 架，訂單共 155 架。

en.title: Jet2 retires world’s oldest Boeing 737‑800 after 29 years
en.summary: Jet2 retires G‑GDFD 737‑800; final flight LS644 from Ibiza to East Midlands, then ferried to Manchester for de‑branding.
body: Jet2 has retired a 29‑year‑old Boeing 737‑800 (registration G‑GDFD), ending the service life of the world’s oldest aircraft of that type.

The jet performed its final commercial flight LS644 on 18 October, flying from Ibiza to East Midlands Airport (EMA), then was ferried to Manchester the same day for de‑branding ahead of its return to the lessor.

The airframe, MSN 27982, was the second 737‑800 prototype and has logged more than 80,000 flight hours. Jet2 is simultaneously introducing Airbus A321neos, having taken delivery of its 30th neo this summer under a firm order for 155 aircraft.

facts.claim: Jet2 retired a 29‑year‑old Boeing 737‑800 (registration G‑GDFD), the oldest of its type still in service worldwide.
facts.sourceQuote: Jet2 has retired a 29-year-old Boeing 737-800 , ending the flying career of the oldest aircraft of its type still in service worldwide.

facts.claim: The aircraft completed its final commercial flight LS644 on 18 October from Ibiza to East Midlands Airport.
facts.sourceQuote: the aircraft completed its final commercial flight on 18 October, operating flight LS644 from Ibiza to East Midlands Airport.

facts.claim: After the final flight the jet was flown to Manchester the same day for de‑branding and work before return to the lessor.
facts.sourceQuote: It was flown to Manchester the same day for de-branding and work ahead of its return to the lessor.

facts.claim: The airframe (MSN 27982) first flew on 15 August 1997 and was the second 737‑800 prototype, the eighth built for the 737NG programme.
facts.sourceQuote: The aircraft, manufacturer serial number 27982, first flew on 15 August 1997. According to Airliner World , the airframe was only the second 737-800 prototype and the eighth aircraft built for Boeing’s Next Generation programme.

facts.claim: The aircraft accumulated more than 80,000 flight hours during its career.
facts.sourceQuote: The aircraft accumulated more than 80,000 flight hours.

facts.claim: Jet2 took delivery of its 30th Airbus A321neo aircraft this summer as part of a firm order for 155 brand‑new Airbus A321neo aircraft.
facts.sourceQuote: Over the summer, Jet2 took delivery of its 30th Airbus A321neo aircraft as part of Jet2’s firm order for 155 brand-new Airbus A321neo aircraft.
